sources.title: Pro Git — Git Objects
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Git 三方合併：共同祖先與語意衝突
related.titleEn: Git three-way merge: common ancestors and semantic conflicts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付object-map.csv、原始bytes與三層身分變更表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver object-map.csv, raw bytes and the three-layer identity-change table.
related.difference: 建立兩分支各改不同設定行，保留共同祖先並預測merge是否會有文字衝突。
related.differenceEn: Branch from one ancestor, edit separate config lines and predict whether textual conflict occurs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
blob記錄內容，tree記錄路徑、模式與子物件；檔名更動不一定改blob，而commit另含父節點及metadata。
教學基準：5+4+5 = 14 payload_B；對照：5+4 = 9 payload_B。

三方合併比較base、ours、theirs；文字自動合併成功不表示組合後行為正確。
教學基準：10*(2+1) = 30 s；對照：20*(4+1) = 100 s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Blobs store contents, trees store paths, modes and child objects; renaming need not change a blob, while commits also include parents and metadata.
Teaching baseline: 5+4+5 = 14 payload_B; comparison: 5+4 = 9 payload_B.

Three-way merging compares base, ours andtheirs; textual success does not establish correct combined behavior.
Teaching baseline: 10*(2+1) = 30 s; comparison: 20*(4+1) = 100 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: JUnit：三條件決策表與參數化測試
related.titleEn: JUnit: three-condition decision tables and parameterized tests
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付object-map.csv、原始bytes與三層身分變更表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver object-map.csv, raw bytes and the three-layer identity-change table.
related.difference: 八列中僅100以外的三個 member=true 組合通過；擴充後僅 suspended=false 的相同三列通過。逐列以真值表核對，不呼叫待測函式產生答案。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Exactly three original combinations pass: member=true with paid or owner true. After extension only those same three with suspended=false pass. Derive expected values independently of the implementation. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
blob記錄內容，tree記錄路徑、模式與子物件；檔名更動不一定改blob，而commit另含父節點及metadata。
教學基準：5+4+5 = 14 payload_B；對照：5+4 = 9 payload_B。

基準 2**3 = 8 cases；對照 2**4 = 16 cases。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
八列中僅100以外的三個 member=true 組合通過；擴充後僅 suspended=false 的相同三列通過。逐列以真值表核對，不呼叫待測函式產生答案。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Blobs store contents, trees store paths, modes and child objects; renaming need not change a blob, while commits also include parents and metadata.
Teaching baseline: 5+4+5 = 14 payload_B; comparison: 5+4 = 9 payload_B.

Baseline 2**3 = 8 cases; comparison 2**4 = 16 cases. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Exactly three original combinations pass: member=true with paid or owner true. After extension only those same three with suspended=false pass. Derive expected values independently of the implementation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
